summary: Design platform with 185M users — Brand Kit team lock-in is sticky but AI image generation competes heavily on output quality.
moat: Canva's moat is its team collaboration infrastructure and Brand Kit system: organizations store their fonts, colors, logos, and templates inside Canva, making it the single source of brand truth for marketing teams globally. With 85% of Fortune 500 companies using Canva for Teams, the switching cost involves recreating brand kits and re-training teams. Its 185 million user base also drives a powerful network of shared template remixing.

challengers.name: Adobe Firefly and professional AI design tools
challengers.evidence: Adobe Firefly generated 9 billion images in its first year and is integrated into Photoshop and Illustrator, giving professional designers AI image superpowers inside tools that outclass Canva for complex creative work.
